Warden_02_9231a976.text: Something that was never meant to wake [glitch]is waking[/].

Warden_04_555273b6.text: I have kept this door [beat] since before your stars had [hot]names[/].

Warden_06_82d0b201.text: You fight like the rift itself. [beat] [hot]Without end.[/]

Warden_09_55914989.text: The door [hot]STAYS SHUT[/]. [beat] Even if I must close it [glitch]with you inside[/].

Warden_11_388c73aa.text: [slow]Go on, then.[/] [beat] See what waits [hot]behind it[/].

Warden_12_b35642b3.text: The door closes. [beat] [wave]Remember what you could not finish.[/]

Choir_01_9ec04e62.text: [wave]A note, held too long, begins to [hot]crack[/].[/]

Choir_03_9fccdaba.text: [wave]Seven voices woke.[/] [beat] One of them is singing [hot]for you[/].

Choir_04_e22678de.text: Listen. [beat] Between every note, there is a place to [hot]stand[/].

Choir_05_1bc30726.text: Find it. [beat] Or we shall sing you [shake]quiet[/].

Choir_06_c8c007ae.text: [big]Louder.[/] The hall has not heard a true [hot]chord[/] in an age.

Choir_09_bdc99e46.text: [glitch]Let the whole hall shatter with us![/]

Regent_04_5828a183.text: You trespass on my throne [beat] and expect [slow]mercy?[/]

Regent_05_8b76a41c.text: Let the fire decide [beat] [shake]how long you last.[/]

Regent_08_025c0c94.text: [big][shake]BURN.[/][/] Burn it all -- the throne, the sky, [hot]you[/]!

Regent_09_90a564c4.text: [glitch]If I fall, the world falls with me![/]

Regent_11_8902ca43.text: [whisper]The crown is yours.[/] [beat] It was always [hot]heavy[/].

Regent_12_35080f35.text: I retreat to my [hot]embers[/]. [beat] Not to you.

Seraph_01_ec0c81d4.text: The air tastes of [hot]iron[/]. [beat] Something is [pulse]gathering[/].

Seraph_02_4d3e67bb.text: [whisper]Do you hear the wires of the sky?[/]

Seraph_03_ff1b1cac.text: I am the storm that was [hot]promised[/].

Seraph_04_3f144739.text: Every wire of the sky [wave]answers me[/].

Seraph_05_adf4fb5e.text: [slow]Stand still.[/] [beat] It will be over before the [big]thunder[/].

Seraph_12_8b1a087b.text: The storm moves on. [beat] [hot]So will its thunder.[/]

Rime_01_3af21162.text: [wave]Ice creaks.[/] [beat] Something very [slow]old[/] is turning over.

Rime_03_244faa1d.text: I have waited under the snow for [hot]ten thousand winters[/].

Rime_04_b25a995f.text: You are [wave]warm[/]. [beat] Warm things do not last here.

Rime_07_85513fdb.text: [wave]Frost on your breath... on your blade...[/]

Rime_12_edf162b6.text: I sink back into the ice. [beat] It will [hot]keep[/].

Knight_03_c1d23469.text: I swore an oath to the [hot]space between stars[/].

Knight_04_d2d8c677.text: No crown. [beat] No name. [beat] [slow]Only the blade.[/]

Knight_05_d52fdcc3.text: [big]Draw.[/] [beat] Let us see what you are [hot]made of[/].

Knight_09_2b297e89.text: [glitch]I will be nothing -- and nothing cannot be cut![/]

Knight_11_b4c38497.text: The oath is ended. [beat] [hot]The dark is yours.[/]

Warden_13_59ded037.text: [shake]You are taking too long.[/] [beat] The door [hot]hungers[/].

Warden_30_6e9a10a7.text: The seal's own edge. [beat] Cross it and be [hot]cut[/].

Warden_41_8010d085.text: Stay. [beat] The seal will [hot]close round you[/].

Regent_21_c17f25d4.text: Is that all the [hot]fire[/] you carry?

Regent_25_e496cc8f.text: Every one of you is a [hot]target[/].

Regent_30_aac616f0.text: The wall advances. Find the [hot]gap[/] -- or [shake]burn[/].

Seraph_19_331d67ca.text: You are a spark. I am the [big]STORM[/].

Knight_35_3ee8420a.text: A wall of night -- find the [hot]gap[/].

Astraeon_02_d5bcdd32.text: The air [pulse]hums[/] with an old, enormous light.

Astraeon_04_ea6d0b63.text: I was the light that taught your sky to [hot]shine[/]. [beat] Now I am only its [shake]ending[/].

Astraeon_07_111cf659.text: Then let me show you [slow]what light does[/] when it is [shake]angry[/].

Astraeon_09_8ea9beaa.text: [glitch]Every star I ever lit -- I take them BACK.[/]

Astraeon_12_214782a7.text: The dark takes me back. [beat] [hot]For now.[/]

Astraeon_18_41e782d4.text: [slow]You cannot dim what burns for ages.[/]

Astraeon_29_9733e77a.text: [shake]One line of light. [beat] Let it find you.[/]
